def reference(vectors):
    q = 0
    result = []
    for row in vectors:
        # sync_reset: synchronous active-high reset at posedge, priority over increment
        reset = row.get('reset', 0) if isinstance(row, dict) else 0
        if reset:
            q = 0
        else:
            # bcd_increment: 4-digit BCD increment modulo 10000
            ones = q & 0xF
            tens = (q >> 4) & 0xF
            hundreds = (q >> 8) & 0xF
            thousands = (q >> 12) & 0xF

            ones += 1
            if ones >= 10:
                ones = 0
                tens += 1
                if tens >= 10:
                    tens = 0
                    hundreds += 1
                    if hundreds >= 10:
                        hundreds = 0
                        thousands += 1
                        if thousands >= 10:
                            thousands = 0

            q = (thousands << 12) | (hundreds << 8) | (tens << 4) | ones

        # upper_digit_enables: combinational from current q after posedge
        ones = q & 0xF
        tens = (q >> 4) & 0xF
        hundreds = (q >> 8) & 0xF

        bit0 = 1 if ones == 9 else 0
        bit1 = 1 if (ones == 9 and tens == 9) else 0
        bit2 = 1 if (ones == 9 and tens == 9 and hundreds == 9) else 0
        ena = bit0 | (bit1 << 1) | (bit2 << 2)

        result.append({'q': q, 'ena': ena})

    return result

    q = 0
    current_reset = 0
    results = []

    for row in vectors:
        # Determine inputs driven before the sampled posedge.
        inp = row
        if "inputs" in row:
            inp = row["inputs"]

        # A value driven in this row updates the held reset input.
        if "reset" in inp:
            current_reset = inp["reset"]

        # Rule sync_reset: synchronous active-high reset has priority at posedge.
        # Rule bcd_increment: otherwise increment the 4-digit BCD counter modulo 10000.
        if current_reset:
            q = 0
        else:
            ones = q & 15
            tens = (q >> 4) & 15
            hundreds = (q >> 8) & 15
            thousands = (q >> 12) & 15

            if ones == 10:

                    hundreds += 1
                    if hundreds == 10:

                        thousands += 1

        tens = (q >> 4) & 15

        bit1 = 1 if (ones == 9 and tens == 9) else 0
        bit2 = 1 if (ones == 9 and tens == 9 and hundreds == 9) else 0
